name: @w6w-apps/assemblyai
description: Transcribe audio and video and run Audio Intelligence (speaker labels, key phrases, content moderation, topic detection, entity detection, sentiment analysis, PII redaction) with AssemblyAI.

w6w.longDescription:
AssemblyAI turns audio and video into text and turns that text into structured insight — this app covers the full Speech-to-Text lifecycle (submit a URL-reachable file, poll or wait for the result, list and delete transcripts) plus the Audio Intelligence add-ons AssemblyAI enables as flags on that same submit call: speaker diarization, key phrases, content moderation, topic detection, entity detection, sentiment analysis, and PII redaction (text and, optionally, a beeped-out audio copy).

`transcript-submit-and-wait` is the one-call path for the common case of "transcribe this and give me the text back"; `transcript-submit` plus `transcript-wait`/a Webhook URL cover everything from fire-and-forget batch jobs to long-running files. Companion actions export the finished transcript as SRT/VTT subtitles, split it into sentences or paragraphs, search it for keywords, and fetch the PII-redacted audio download link.

Every action works with a publicly reachable audio/video URL — this app's sandbox coerces network bodies to strings, which is incompatible with AssemblyAI's separate raw-bytes upload endpoint; see the README for the full explanation.
